articles.title: Pangram’s Max Spero on why AI detection is harder than ‘Real or Fake’
articles.summary: The internet has a trust problem, and it’s not just because social media feeds are filling up with AI slop. AI-generated text and images are now making their way into job applications, product reviews, and even insurance claims, leaving platforms and users alike scrambling to figure out what’s real.
